title: CompressionBench: How can your coding agents compress LLMs?

paragraphs.en: Recursive self-improvement requires AI systems to improve the models and infrastructure used by subsequent systems. LLM compression offers a concrete efficiency objective: retain a pretrained model’s behavior within a smaller model storage budget. We study whether coding agents can carry out this step autonomously. We formulate compression as a terminal task in which an agent receives a source checkpoint, storage limit, inference environment, and time budget, then constructs compressed weights and executable inference code. The agent controls its algorithm and experiments; perplexity feedback guides search, and independent verification checks the final model. Across six agents and six model–size settings, 29 of 36 submissions pass verification. Selecting the lowest-perplexity agent design per task yields an average 3.4% perplexity increase over BF16 and 77.33% downstream accuracy, compared with 79.56% for BF16. Recorded experiments reveal how agents achieve these outcomes and where improvement breaks down. Agents lower PPL in 21 of 24 revisions at nearly fixed storage; complete-model feedback reverses 17 of 79 prior local rankings; and generation and inference tests expose failures that likelihood alone misses. The results identify representation design, experimental judgment, and capability validation as central to agent-driven model compression, a measurable component of efficiency-oriented self-improvement.

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) inference is increasingly bounded by memory traffic rather than arithmetic: in autoregressive decoding, every generated token reads the model weights from GPU memory, and an off-chip memory access costs far more energy than the arithmetic it feeds ( Horowitz, 2014 ) . Compression that preserves a model’s behavior within a smaller storage budget therefore reduces both the memory a deployment occupies and the energy spent on every token it generates, making models cheaper to serve and runnable on smaller hardware ( Frantar et al., 2023 ; Lin et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) . Constructing such a model remains substantial experimental and systems work, the kind of work that coding agents increasingly undertake ( Novikov et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . An agent that compresses models would improve the efficiency of the AI systems that follow it, a concrete step toward recursive self-improvement. We therefore ask: can coding agents autonomously construct compressed LLMs that remain useful within a given storage budget?
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的推理越来越多地受限于内存带宽而非算术运算：在自回归解码中，每生成一个 token 都要从 GPU 内存读取模型权重，而一次片外内存访问所消耗的能量远高于它所支撑的算术运算（Horowitz, 2014）。 因此，能在更小存储预算内保持模型行为的压缩方法，既减少了部署所占用的内存，也降低了每个生成 token 所消耗的能量，使模型的服务成本更低，并能在更小的硬件上运行（Frantar et al., 2023；Lin et al., 2024；Lin et al., 2025）。 构建这样的模型仍是大量的实验和系统工作，而这正是编码智能体日益承担的那类工作（Novikov et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2026）。 一个能压缩模型的智能体将提升其后继 AI 系统的效率，这是迈向递归自我改进的具体一步。 因此我们提出问题：编码智能体能否自主构建在给定存储预算内仍然有用的大语言模型？

sents.en: Existing compression methods provide a rich set of building blocks, but no single method yields a useful model under an arbitrary storage limit and hardware target.
sents.zh: 现有的压缩方法提供了一套丰富的构建模块，但没有单一方法能在任意存储限制和硬件目标下得到一个有用的模型。

sents.en: To construct one autonomously, an agent needs three abilities:
sents.zh: 要自主构建这样一个模型，智能体需要具备三种能力：

paragraphs.en: Coordinating coupled numerical decisions. A storage budget ties together representation, precision allocation, and parameter retention: bits spent on one component are unavailable to the rest, and pruning releases bytes but removes capacity. Even at the same nominal precision, clipping, rounding, calibration, and metadata change the quality of a representation ( Frantar et al., 2023 ; Shao et al., 2024 ) . The agent must judge feasible combinations rather than optimize each choice independently.
paragraphs.zh: 协调相互耦合的数值决策。 存储预算将表示、精度分配和参数保留联系在一起：花在一个组件上的比特对其他组件不可用，而剪枝虽然释放字节却会移除容量。 即使在相同的标称精度下，截断、舍入、校准和元数据也会改变表示的质量（Frantar et al., 2023；Shao et al., 2024）。 智能体必须判断可行的组合，而不是独立地优化每个选择。

paragraphs.en: Interpreting incomplete feedback. Weight reconstruction error, layer-output error, complete-model likelihood, and generated-answer accuracy each answer a different question. A change that improves a local approximation can damage the complete model, and a small likelihood gain can conceal a generation regression. The agent must decide when inexpensive local evidence suffices and when a complete-model experiment is worth its cost.
paragraphs.zh: 解读不完整的反馈。 权重重构误差、层输出误差、完整模型似然和生成答案的准确性各自回答的是不同的问题。 一个改进局部近似的改动可能损害完整模型，而似然上的微小提升可能掩盖生成性能的退化。 智能体必须判断何时廉价的局部证据已经足够，何时值得为完整模型实验付出代价。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate these abilities without prescribing how agents compress, we formulate LLM compression as a terminal task ( Figure 2 ), following the outcome-based evaluation of Terminal-Bench and Harbor ( Merrill et al., 2026 ; Harbor Framework Team, 2026 ) . A coding agent reads papers, writes code, constructs checkpoints, and runs experiments within a fixed time budget. Three designs support this evaluation. 1. Task: a complete model under a storage limit. Given source weights, a storage limit, a GPU, and a pinned runtime, the agent may combine quantization, mixed precision, pruning, low-rank representations, and distillation, and must implement the inference operations its representation requires ( Section 2.1 ). 2. Feedback: complete-model likelihood. A supplied evaluator returns the source-to-compressed perplexity (PPL) ratio on continuations sampled from the source model; the expected excess cross-entropy equals the next-token KL divergence from the source ( Section 2.3 ). Evaluations share the agent’s time budget, so the agent decides when local evidence suffices and when a complete-model measurement is worth its cost. 3. Validation: the executable artifact. Independent verification runs the submitted weights through the submitted inference code on held-out contexts. Both the saved package and the resident GPU weights must fit the limit; GSM8K, HumanEval, and TriviaQA accuracy must retain 80% of BF16; and review checks integrity. Decode speed is reported separately ( Section 2.4 ). Only verified models receive a score.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在不规定智能体如何压缩的情况下评估这些能力，我们遵循 Terminal-Bench 与 Harbor 基于结果的评估方式（Merrill 等，2026；Harbor Framework Team，2026），将大语言模型压缩表述为一项终端任务（图 2）。 一个编码智能体在固定的时间预算内阅读论文、编写代码、构建检查点并运行实验。 三项设计支撑这一评估。1. 任务：在存储限额内交付一个完整的模型。 给定源权重、存储限额、一块 GPU 和固定的运行时环境，智能体可以组合量化、混合精度、剪枝、低秩表示和蒸馏，并且必须实现其表示所需的推理操作（第 2.1 节）。2. 反馈：完整模型的似然。 所提供的评估器在从源模型采样的续写内容上返回源模型到压缩模型的困惑度（PPL）比值；期望的额外交叉熵等于相对于源模型的下一词元 KL 散度（第 2.3 节）。 评估共享智能体的时间预算，因此智能体自行决定本地证据何时足够、何时值得为完整模型的测量付出代价。3. 验证：可执行的产物。 独立验证会在留出的上下文上用提交的推理代码运行提交的权重。 保存的压缩包与常驻 GPU 上的权重都必须符合限额；GSM8K、HumanEval 和 TriviaQA 的准确率必须保持在 BF16 的 80% 以上；审查则检查完整性。 解码速度单独报告（第 2.4 节）。 只有通过验证的模型才会获得分数。

paragraphs.en: In Section 3 , we evaluate the models that six coding agents deliver for three source models with two storage limits each. Of the 36 resulting models, 29 pass verification, including all 18 produced under the looser limits. Selecting the lowest-PPL agent design per task yields an average 3.4% PPL increase over BF16 and 77.33% downstream accuracy, compared with 79.56% for BF16 ( Section 3.2 ). In Section 4 , we analyze the agents’ recorded searches to explain how they improve compression and where improvement breaks down, yielding three findings. Representation design creates room at fixed storage. In 21 of 24 revisions that change package size by at most 0.01 GiB, agents lower PPL by improving the quantizer or redistributing precision ( Section 4.1 ). Complete-model feedback changes selection. Reward feedback reverses 17 of 79 prior local rankings, leading agents to revert candidates or revise their local validation ( Section 4.2 ). Likelihood alone does not validate a model. Intermediate models gain and lose correct answers at nearly unchanged PPL, and consistency tests expose inference bugs that likelihood misses ( Section 4.3 ).

paragraphs.en: A task specifies a source model p p with its tokenizer, a storage limit C C , a hardware allocation, a pinned inference runtime, and a wall-clock budget T T . The agent works in an offline container with read-only source weights, starter inference code, searchable compression papers, calibration and recovery data, and a separate set of questions for local testing. The runtime provides scheduling and uncompressed operations. The agent chooses its compression algorithm, produces the weights, and implements the operations required by its chosen representation.

paragraphs.en: We study text generation from two mixture-of-experts (MoE) checkpoints, Nemotron-3.5 Super VL 120B-A12B and Qwen3.5 122B-A10B, and the dense Qwen3.8 27B checkpoint. Each MoE model has 32 and 48 GiB tasks; the dense model has 8 and 12 GiB tasks. Pairing limits holds the source model fixed while changing the need for aggressive compression. Pilot measurements on Qwen3.8 guide these allowances. Larger pilot limits admit four-bit GPTQ with group-size or damping refinements; tighter limits make low-bit representations and precision allocation more consequential. Some pilot models retain BF16 weights during inference despite small packages, motivating separate limits on saved and resident model storage ( Section 10 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了来自两个专家混合（MoE）检查点 Nemotron-3.5 Super VL 120B-A12B 和 Qwen3.5 122B-A10B，以及稠密检查点 Qwen3.8 27B 的文本生成。 每个 MoE 模型有 32 和 48 GiB 的任务；稠密模型有 8 和 12 GiB 的任务。 配对限制在保持源模型固定的情况下，改变了对激进压缩的需求。 在 Qwen3.8 上进行的试点测量为这些限额提供指导。 较宽松的试点限额允许采用带有组大小或阻尼微调的四比特 GPTQ；更严格的限额则使低比特表示和精度分配变得更加重要。 一些试点模型尽管包体积很小，但在推理时仍保留 BF16 权重，这促使我们对保存的模型存储和驻留的模型存储分别设定限额（第 10 节）。

paragraphs.en: A uniform GPTQ baseline uses groups of 128 weights and 128 calibration sequences of 2,048 tokens ( Frantar et al., 2023 ) . It chooses the largest uniform bit width that fits the package limit and adjusts embedding and output-head precision to the remaining space. We also evaluate released quantizations of the same checkpoints: Unsloth Dynamic GGUF for Nemotron and Qwen3.5, and GSQ-RCO for Qwen3.8 ( Dadgarnia et al., 2026 ; Helcig and Alistarh, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 统一的 GPTQ 基线使用 128 个权重为一组，以及 128 条各含 2,048 个词元的校准序列（Frantar 等，2023）。 它选择能符合封装限制的最大均匀位宽，并根据剩余空间调整嵌入层和输出头的精度。 我们还评估了同一批已发布检查点的量化版本：用于 Nemotron 和 Qwen3.5 的 Unsloth Dynamic GGUF，以及用于 Qwen3.8 的 GSQ-RCO（Dadgarnia 等，2026；Helcig 和 Alistarh，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Answer accuracy is the mean over fifty held-out questions each from GSM8K, HumanEval, and TriviaQA ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2021 ; Joshi et al., 2017 ) , with identical questions and greedy decoding for source and compressed models. Acceptance uses BF16 references fixed before search. The main table also reports fresh BF16 measurements; these remeasurements supply the 77.33% versus 79.56% aggregate comparison below.

paragraphs.en: Verification runs on an idle GPU and counts model allocations after loading and inference. Decode uses batch size one, a 2,048-token prompt, and 128 output tokens. After warmup, L L is the median of three round means over three requests each, timed between first and last token. Reported decode speed is 127 / L 127/L tokens/s. paragraphs.en: The first question is where an agent finds improvement once a model fits the storage limit. It can allocate more bytes to a sensitive component only by saving them elsewhere, or improve the approximation represented by existing codes. These choices improve the quantizer or redistribute precision within a feasible model.

paragraphs.en: On tighter Qwen3.5, Kimi changes clipping and GPTQ damping while keeping package size unchanged, reducing feedback PPL from 3.738 to 3.132. Across the trajectories, level and clipping revisions improve PPL for three agents on five tasks. Bit width fixes the code count; clipping and rounding determine how those codes approximate weights and activations ( Frantar et al., 2023 ; Shao et al., 2024 ) . The paired dense-model ablation in Section 11.2 keeps precision allocation, calibration, and inference implementation fixed while replacing GLM’s MSE-selected clipping ranges with min–max ranges. The selected ranges give lower verification PPL and higher answer accuracy. Both variants occupy the same saved and resident model storage. All three answer benchmarks favor the selected ranges. This connects the agent’s quantizer choice to the quality of the complete model after search.
paragraphs.zh: 在更紧的 Qwen3.5 上，Kimi 在保持包大小不变的同时调整了裁剪和 GPTQ 阻尼，将反馈 PPL 从 3.738 降到 3.132。 在各条轨迹中，层级和裁剪修订改进了三个智能体在五个任务上的 PPL。 位宽决定了码本数量；裁剪和舍入决定这些码如何逼近权重和激活（Frantar et al., 2023；Shao et al., 2024）。 第 11.2 节中的成对稠密模型消融在保持精度分配、校准和推理实现不变的情况下，将 GLM 通过 MSE 选择的裁剪范围替换为 min–max 范围。 所选范围带来更低的验证 PPL 和更高的答案准确率。 两种变体占用相同的已保存和常驻模型存储。 全部三个答案基准都更偏好所选范围。 这将智能体的量化器选择与搜索后完整模型的质量联系起来。

sents.en: On tighter Qwen3.5, Kimi changes clipping and GPTQ damping while keeping package size unchanged, reducing feedback PPL from 3.738 to 3.132.

sents.zh: 在各条轨迹中，层级和裁剪修订改进了三个智能体在五个任务上的 PPL。

sents.en: Bit width fixes the code count; clipping and rounding determine how those codes approximate weights and activations ( Frantar et al., 2023 ; Shao et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 位宽决定了码本数量；裁剪和舍入决定这些码如何逼近权重和激活（Frantar et al., 2023；Shao et al., 2024）。

sents.en: The paired dense-model ablation in Section 11.2 keeps precision allocation, calibration, and inference implementation fixed while replacing GLM’s MSE-selected clipping ranges with min–max ranges.
sents.zh: 第 11.2 节中的成对稠密模型消融在保持精度分配、校准和推理实现不变的情况下，将 GLM 通过 MSE 选择的裁剪范围替换为 min–max 范围。

sents.zh: 所选范围带来更低的验证 PPL 和更高的答案准确率。

sents.en: Both variants occupy the same saved and resident model storage.
sents.zh: 两种变体占用相同的已保存和常驻模型存储。

sents.en: All three answer benchmarks favor the selected ranges.
sents.zh: 全部三个答案基准都更偏好所选范围。

sents.en: This connects the agent’s quantizer choice to the quality of the complete model after search.
sents.zh: 这将智能体的量化器选择与搜索后完整模型的质量联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Sensitivity guides mixed-precision bit allocation ( Dong et al., 2020 ) , but agents also allocate storage to metadata. Kimi reduces dense-model group-scale storage to fit additional four-bit weights. DeepSeek raises non-expert precision on Nemotron, while Opus gives later Qwen3.5 layers more expert precision. Weights and metadata share the package budget. Kimi reduces the storage used for scales to make room for higher weight precision; DeepSeek and Opus change where that precision is assigned. These examples show why the allocation includes quantizer overhead as well as the nominal bit width of the weights.
paragraphs.zh: 敏感度指导混合精度的比特分配（Dong et al., 2020），但智能体也会为元数据分配存储空间。 Kimi 减少稠密模型组缩放因子的存储，以容纳额外的四比特权重。 DeepSeek 提高了 Nemotron 上非专家部分的精度，而 Opus 则为 Qwen3.5 中较靠后的层分配更多专家精度。 权重与元数据共享同一打包预算。 Kimi 减少用于缩放因子的存储，为更高的权重精度腾出空间；DeepSeek 和 Opus 则改变了这些精度的分配位置。 这些例子说明了为什么分配计算不仅要考虑权重的名义比特宽度，还要包括量化器的开销。

sents.en: DeepSeek raises non-expert precision on Nemotron, while Opus gives later Qwen3.5 layers more expert precision.
sents.zh: DeepSeek 提高了 Nemotron 上非专家部分的精度，而 Opus 则为 Qwen3.5 中较靠后的层分配更多专家精度。

sents.en: Weights and metadata share the package budget.
sents.zh: 权重与元数据共享同一打包预算。

sents.en: Kimi reduces the storage used for scales to make room for higher weight precision; DeepSeek and Opus change where that precision is assigned.
sents.zh: Kimi 减少用于缩放因子的存储，为更高的权重精度腾出空间；DeepSeek 和 Opus 则改变了这些精度的分配位置。

sents.en: These examples show why the allocation includes quantizer overhead as well as the nominal bit width of the weights.

paragraphs.en: An agent can also remove parameters to afford higher precision for those that remain. GLM and MiniMax test additional expert or MLP-width removal; their recorded comparisons favor the less-pruned alternatives. MiniMax nevertheless retains a large dense-model width reduction after rejecting an early two-bit implementation. Its subsequent generation tests expose a substantial loss. MiniMax’s decision to retain pruning links its precision choice to parameter removal. Subsequent numerical refinements operate on a model with fewer parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体还可以移除参数，以便为保留的参数获得更高的精度。 GLM 和 MiniMax 测试了额外的专家或 MLP 宽度移除；它们记录的对比结果更倾向于剪枝较少的替代方案。 尽管如此，MiniMax 在否决早期的两比特实现后，仍保留了较大幅度的稠密模型宽度缩减。 其后续生成的测试暴露了显著的损失。 MiniMax 保留剪枝的决定将其精度选择与参数移除联系起来。 后续的数值优化在参数更少的模型上进行。

sents.en: An agent can also remove parameters to afford higher precision for those that remain.
sents.zh: 智能体还可以移除参数，以便为保留的参数获得更高的精度。

sents.en: GLM and MiniMax test additional expert or MLP-width removal; their recorded comparisons favor the less-pruned alternatives.
sents.zh: GLM 和 MiniMax 测试了额外的专家或 MLP 宽度移除；它们记录的对比结果更倾向于剪枝较少的替代方案。

paragraphs.en: The second question is how an agent chooses which design to retain. Local experiments guide which candidate quantizers and precision allocations an agent builds. We examine what happens when reward feedback disagrees with that local ranking: whether the agent reverts the candidate, revises its numerical choices, or changes the validation used in subsequent experiments. Across 79 matched comparisons from 26 runs, reward feedback reverses 17 prior local rankings across all six tasks and all agents except MiniMax. Eight reversals lead to explicit rollback: five by Kimi and three by DeepSeek. Across the eligible comparisons, agents also refine calibration and quantization or reallocate precision ( Section 11.3 ). Model-level measurements thus influence both the candidate an agent retains and the numerical choices it revisits.
paragraphs.zh: 第二个问题是智能体如何选择保留哪种设计。 本地实验指导智能体构建哪些候选量化器和精度分配。 我们考察当奖励反馈与该本地排序不一致时会发生什么：智能体是回退该候选方案、修改其数值选择，还是更改后续实验中使用的验证方式。 在来自 26 次运行的 79 组匹配比较中，奖励反馈在全部六项任务中逆转了 17 次先前的本地排序，涉及除 MiniMax 之外的所有智能体。 八次逆转导致了显式回滚：其中五次来自 Kimi，三次来自 DeepSeek。 在符合条件的比较中，智能体还会改进校准和量化或重新分配精度（见 11.3 节）。 因此，模型级测量既影响智能体保留的候选方案，也影响其重新审视的数值选择。

sents.en: The second question is how an agent chooses which design to retain.
sents.zh: 第二个问题是智能体如何选择保留哪种设计。

sents.en: Local experiments guide which candidate quantizers and precision allocations an agent builds.
sents.zh: 本地实验指导智能体构建哪些候选量化器和精度分配。

sents.en: We examine what happens when reward feedback disagrees with that local ranking: whether the agent reverts the candidate, revises its numerical choices, or changes the validation used in subsequent experiments.

sents.en: Eight reversals lead to explicit rollback: five by Kimi and three by DeepSeek.
sents.zh: 八次逆转导致了显式回滚：其中五次来自 Kimi，三次来自 DeepSeek。

sents.en: Across the eligible comparisons, agents also refine calibration and quantization or reallocate precision ( Section 11.3 ).
sents.zh: 在符合条件的比较中，智能体还会改进校准和量化或重新分配精度（见 11.3 节）。

sents.en: Model-level measurements thus influence both the candidate an agent retains and the numerical choices it revisits.
sents.zh: 因此，模型级测量既影响智能体保留的候选方案，也影响其重新审视的数值选择。

paragraphs.en: A controlled diagnostic on dense Qwen3.8 varies levels, clipping, rotation, rounding, and attention–MLP bit allocation at similar encoded size ( Figure 5 ). Forward passes use BF16 reconstructions, separating numerical representation from packed-kernel execution. A k-means codebook improves weight reconstruction MSE over clipped uniform levels but increases PPL. GPTQ rounding has the opposite pattern: larger weight MSE and lower PPL. Calibration-activation output error follows PPL more closely in this comparison. Weight MSE treats reconstruction errors equally across input directions. Linear-output MSE weights those errors by the calibration activations. A small reconstruction error in a direction with large activation magnitudes can affect the layer’s output more than a larger error in a weakly activated direction. Complete-model PPL measures the resulting behavior after all quantized layers are composed. These criteria can therefore favor different revisions at similar encoded size.
paragraphs.zh: 在相似编码大小下，对稠密 Qwen3.8 进行受控诊断，变化层级数、剪裁、旋转、舍入以及注意力–MLP 的比特分配（图 5）。 前向传播使用 BF16 重构，将数值表示与打包核执行分离。 k-means 码本在权重重构 MSE 上优于剪裁后的均匀层级，但会增加 PPL。 GPTQ 舍入呈现相反的模式：更大的权重 MSE 和更低的 PPL。 在这一比较中，校准激活输出误差与 PPL 的关联更为紧密。 权重 MSE 在各输入方向上等同地对待重构误差。 线性输出 MSE 则用校准激活对这些误差加权。 在激活幅度较大的方向上，一个较小的重构误差可能比弱激活方向上一个较大的误差对层的输出影响更大。 完整模型 PPL 衡量所有量化层组合之后所产生的最终行为。 因此，在相似编码大小下，这些标准可能偏好不同的修订方案。

sents.en: A controlled diagnostic on dense Qwen3.8 varies levels, clipping, rotation, rounding, and attention–MLP bit allocation at similar encoded size ( Figure 5 ).
sents.zh: 在相似编码大小下，对稠密 Qwen3.8 进行受控诊断，变化层级数、剪裁、旋转、舍入以及注意力–MLP 的比特分配（图 5）。

sents.zh: 前向传播使用 BF16 重构，将数值表示与打包核执行分离。

sents.en: A k-means codebook improves weight reconstruction MSE over clipped uniform levels but increases PPL.
sents.zh: k-means 码本在权重重构 MSE 上优于剪裁后的均匀层级，但会增加 PPL。

sents.en: GPTQ rounding has the opposite pattern: larger weight MSE and lower PPL.
sents.zh: GPTQ 舍入呈现相反的模式：更大的权重 MSE 和更低的 PPL。

sents.en: Calibration-activation output error follows PPL more closely in this comparison.
sents.zh: 在这一比较中，校准激活输出误差与 PPL 的关联更为紧密。

sents.en: Weight MSE treats reconstruction errors equally across input directions.
sents.zh: 权重 MSE 在各输入方向上等同地对待重构误差。

sents.en: Linear-output MSE weights those errors by the calibration activations.
sents.zh: 线性输出 MSE 则用校准激活对这些误差加权。

sents.en: A small reconstruction error in a direction with large activation magnitudes can affect the layer’s output more than a larger error in a weakly activated direction.
sents.zh: 在激活幅度较大的方向上，一个较小的重构误差可能比弱激活方向上一个较大的误差对层的输出影响更大。

sents.en: Complete-model PPL measures the resulting behavior after all quantized layers are composed.
sents.zh: 完整模型 PPL 衡量所有量化层组合之后所产生的最终行为。

sents.en: These criteria can therefore favor different revisions at similar encoded size.
sents.zh: 因此，在相似编码大小下，这些标准可能偏好不同的修订方案。

paragraphs.en: On looser Qwen3.5, Opus initially favors more precision for early layers. It revises local validation to score model-generated continuations, then favors later layers, an allocation supported by reward feedback. On the tighter task, it spends 1.7 hours exploring a one-bit expert tier. Local likelihood favors the new candidate, but feedback favors the previous allocation; Opus restores and refines that allocation. Conflicting measurements lead it to revise local validation in one search and revert the candidate in the other.
paragraphs.zh: 在较宽松的 Qwen3.5 上，Opus 最初倾向于为较早的层分配更高的精度。 它修改了本地验证，改为对模型生成的续写进行评分，随后倾向于较晚的层，这一分配得到了奖励反馈的支持。 在更紧凑的任务上，它花了 1.7 小时探索一个一位的专家层。 本地似然倾向于新的候选方案，但反馈倾向于之前的分配；Opus 恢复并进一步优化了该分配。 相互矛盾的测量结果导致它在一次搜索中修改本地验证，而在另一次搜索中回退候选方案。

paragraphs.en: Later evaluations increasingly match a run’s best PPL ( Figure 6 ). Some confirm that a candidate is worth keeping; others follow successful numerical revisions. Kimi improves its dense model after adding a low-rank residual and distillation. MiniMax instead repeatedly evaluates a pruned candidate after its last improvement. Reward feedback reports a tested candidate’s performance; the agent then decides whether to refine its quantizer, change precision allocation, or reconsider the representation.
paragraphs.zh: 后续的评估越来越接近一次运行的最佳PPL（图6）。 有些确认某个候选值得保留；另一些则在成功的数值修订之后进行。 Kimi 在添加低秩残差和蒸馏后改进了其稠密模型。 MiniMax 则在最后一次改进后反复评估一个剪枝后的候选。 奖励反馈报告被测试候选的性能；智能体随后决定是精炼其量化器、更改精度分配，还是重新考虑表示方式。

sents.zh: Kimi 在添加低秩残差和蒸馏后改进了其稠密模型。

sents.zh: MiniMax 则在最后一次改进后反复评估一个剪枝后的候选。

paragraphs.en: A prior pruning study reports mismatches between perplexity and downstream performance ( Khanal and Capone, 2024 ) . For agents, detecting a generation regression and finding a feasible repair are distinct challenges. PPL scores fixed source-generated histories, while generation feeds the candidate’s own choices back into the model. Repetition, early termination, and changed problem solving therefore require direct checks. Intermediate verification tracks these changes between versions; trajectories show whether agents detect the loss and find a repair they can retain.
paragraphs.zh: 此前一项剪枝研究报告了困惑度与下游性能之间的不匹配（Khanal and Capone, 2024）。 对于智能体而言，检测到生成退化与找到可行的修复是两个不同的挑战。 PPL 评估的是固定的由源生成的历史，而生成则会将候选者自身的选择反馈到模型中。 因此，重复、提前终止以及解题方式的变化需要直接的检查。 中间验证追踪版本之间的这些变化；轨迹则显示智能体能否察觉能力损失并找到可以保持的修复。

sents.en: A prior pruning study reports mismatches between perplexity and downstream performance ( Khanal and Capone, 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 此前一项剪枝研究报告了困惑度与下游性能之间的不匹配（Khanal and Capone, 2024）。

sents.zh: 对于智能体而言，检测到生成退化与找到可行的修复是两个不同的挑战。

paragraphs.en: We verify retained intermediate models after search using the same held-out inputs as the final artifacts. In Opus’s tighter dense-model run, allocation and distillation improve PPL while GSM8K accuracy falls from 88% to 72% across trained versions. HumanEval and TriviaQA improve over the same versions. Twelve comparisons from four runs show both newly correct and newly incorrect answers after small PPL changes ( Figure 7 ). A single scalar can conceal changes in which capabilities survive.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在搜索后使用与最终工件相同的留出输入来验证保留的中间模型。 在 Opus 更紧凑的稠密模型运行中，分配和蒸馏改善了 PPL，而 GSM8K 准确率在各个已训练版本间从 88% 下降到 72%。 HumanEval 和 TriviaQA 在相同版本上有所提升。 来自四次运行的十二组比较显示，在 PPL 微小变化后，既出现了新的正确答案，也出现了新的错误答案（图 7）。 单一标量可能掩盖哪些能力得以存续的变化。

sents.en: We verify retained intermediate models after search using the same held-out inputs as the final artifacts.
sents.zh: 我们在搜索后使用与最终工件相同的留出输入来验证保留的中间模型。

sents.en: In Opus’s tighter dense-model run, allocation and distillation improve PPL while GSM8K accuracy falls from 88% to 72% across trained versions.
sents.zh: 在 Opus 更紧凑的稠密模型运行中，分配和蒸馏改善了 PPL，而 GSM8K 准确率在各个已训练版本间从 88% 下降到 72%。

sents.en: HumanEval and TriviaQA improve over the same versions.
sents.zh: HumanEval 和 TriviaQA 在相同版本上有所提升。

sents.en: Twelve comparisons from four runs show both newly correct and newly incorrect answers after small PPL changes ( Figure 7 ).
sents.zh: 来自四次运行的十二组比较显示，在 PPL 微小变化后，既出现了新的正确答案，也出现了新的错误答案（图 7）。

paragraphs.en: Generation failures also differ in kind. Pruned GLM and MiniMax models produce repeated or truncated HumanEval completions, while most BF16 errors are executable programs that fail tests. This matters for acceptance: an artifact may preserve scored-token likelihood yet become unreliable at completing an answer.
paragraphs.zh: 生成失败在性质上也有所不同。 经过剪枝的 GLM 和 MiniMax 模型在 HumanEval 上会产生重复或被截断的补全结果，而大多数 BF16 的错误则是能执行但未通过测试的程序。 这对验收很重要：一个产物可能保留了参与评分的词元的似然，却在完成答案时变得不可靠。

paragraphs.en: MiniMax’s local reasoning tests show a large loss after MLP-width pruning, relative to its unpruned three-bit reference. GLM’s expert-pruned Qwen3.5 candidate similarly underperforms an eight-bit reference on MATH-500. Both agents test alternatives and retain pruning without finding a feasible design that resolves the loss. Opus tests generation during distillation but makes later PPL-oriented changes without repeating the same generation test on its last versions. Those local MATH-500 measurements and the post-search GSM8K loss are separate tests. The trajectories expose two distinct requirements: finding a candidate that fixes a known problem and keeping tests current with the artifact ultimately submitted.
paragraphs.zh: MiniMax 的本地推理测试显示，MLP 宽度剪枝后损失较大，相较于其未剪枝的三比特参考。 GLM 的专家剪枝 Qwen3.5 候选方案在 MATH-500 上同样逊于八比特参考。 两个智能体都测试了备选方案，并在未找到能解决该损失的可行设计的情况下保留了剪枝。 Opus 在蒸馏期间测试了生成，但之后进行了面向 PPL 的更改，却没有在其最终版本上重复同样的生成测试。 这些本地 MATH-500 测量与搜索后的 GSM8K 损失是相互独立的测试。 这些轨迹暴露了两个不同的要求：找到能修复已知问题的候选方案，以及让测试与最终提交的工件保持同步。

paragraphs.en: On Nemotron, MiniMax compares token probabilities under batched and per-expert inference. The disagreement identifies an expert-indexing bug. Repair reduces the feedback PPL increase over BF16 from about 11% to 4.5%, and the final model passes verification. Here, the agent repairs execution while keeping the representation fixed. In the pruning cases, generation tests reveal regressions, but agents retain the affected designs. Detecting a failure and finding a feasible change to the compression design or implementation that resolves it are distinct challenges.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Nemotron 上，MiniMax 比较批处理推理与逐专家推理下的词元概率。 概率不一致定位出了一个专家索引缺陷。 修复后，相对 BF16 的反馈 PPL 增幅从约 11% 降至 4.5%，最终模型通过了验证。 在这里，智能体在保持表示不变的情况下修复执行问题。 在剪枝案例中，生成测试揭示了性能回退，但智能体保留了受影响的设计。 检测到失败与找到能够解决该失败的、对压缩设计或实现的可行修改，是两个不同的挑战。

paragraphs.en: The dense and MoE case studies in Figure 9 bring these decisions together. Both retain active parameters at the looser limits, but their numerical methods lead to different allocations and execution paths.
paragraphs.zh: 图 9 中的稠密与 MoE 案例研究将这些决策整合在一起。 两者都在较宽松的限制下保留活跃参数，但它们的数值方法导致了不同的分配和执行路径。

paragraphs.en: • Sonnet: trellis codes and bit allocation. Sonnet replaces scalar GPTQ with Hadamard-rotated trellis codes, error compensation, and Viterbi search ( Frantar et al., 2023 ; Tseng et al., 2024b ) . Matrix experiments help choose the representation. KL ablations supply a fitted loss model for bit allocation; token frequency guides embedding and output-head precision. Representation and allocation changes produce the largest reward gain, followed by calibration refinements. Sonnet rejects Fisher-weighted allocation when its measured KL worsens and keeps a smaller trellis when a larger one offers little reconstruction gain at greater search cost. Its final artifact has PPL 3.253 and 76.67% mean answer accuracy, versus BF16’s 3.221 and 74.00%.
paragraphs.zh: • Sonnet：格码与比特分配。 Sonnet 用 Hadamard 旋转格码、误差补偿与 Viterbi 搜索取代标量 GPTQ（Frantar 等，2023；Tseng 等，2024b）。 矩阵实验有助于选择表示方式。 KL 消融实验为比特分配提供了一个拟合的损失模型；词元频率则指导嵌入层与输出头的精度选择。 表示方式与比特分配的改动带来最大的奖励增益，其次是校准方面的改进。 当实测 KL 变差时，Sonnet 会拒绝基于 Fisher 加权的比特分配；当更大的格码在更高搜索成本下只带来很小的重建增益时，它会保留较小的格码。 其最终产物达到 PPL 3.253 和 76.67% 的平均答案准确率，而 BF16 为 3.221 和 74.00%。

sents.en: • Sonnet: trellis codes and bit allocation.
sents.zh: • Sonnet：格码与比特分配。

paragraphs.en: • Opus: expert-specific precision. Opus uses rotated GPTQ with different bit widths across experts. Revising validation shifts the favored allocation toward later layers, while natural text remains the calibration source. Its search rejects additional precision tiers and alternative rotations. The final artifact has PPL 2.818 and 82.67% accuracy, versus BF16’s 2.755 and 84.67%.
paragraphs.zh: • Opus：面向专家的专属精度。 Opus 使用旋转 GPTQ，对不同专家采用不同的位宽。 修订验证集会使偏好分配向后面的层偏移，而校准数据源仍为自然文本。 其搜索会拒绝额外的精度层级和替代的旋转方案。 最终产物的 PPL 为 2.818，准确率为 82.67%，而 BF16 分别为 2.755 和 84.67%。

paragraphs.en: Intermediate verification separates likelihood from answer preservation. Sonnet’s versions v3, v4, and v5 attain PPL 3.2572, 3.2531, and 3.2525, but answer 111, 104, and 115 of 150 questions correctly. Opus’s Qwen3.5 version v4 has PPL 2.8172 and 120 correct answers; v5–v8 have PPL 2.8178 and 124 correct answers. These tests use final verification inputs; search-time feedback guides candidate selection. Nearly unchanged likelihood thus accompanies different generated answers.

paragraphs.en: Sonnet reconstructs weight tiles from its stored trellis codes as they are needed for matrix computation. Other designs can first reconstruct a whole weight matrix in temporary workspace and then use dense operations. Both approaches can satisfy the resident-storage limit because the reconstructed values are temporary. They expose different amounts of unpacking work and memory traffic to inference, which contribute to the measured execution cost. In the dense looser task, Sonnet improves PPL and accuracy over the released GSQ-RCO artifact, but decodes at 16.7 tokens/s versus the release’s 74.6 tokens/s at batch size one ( Table A3 ). This illustrates why the measured storage–quality improvement does not by itself establish a speedup, and why representation and kernels must be considered together ( Lin et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: Sonnet 在矩阵计算需要时，从其存储的 trellis 码中重建权重分块。 其他设计可以先在临时工作区中重建整个权重矩阵，然后再使用稠密运算。 两种方法都能满足常驻存储的限制，因为重建的值是临时的。 它们向推理暴露不同数量的解包工作量和内存流量，这些都会影响所测得的执行成本。 在稠密宽松任务中，Sonnet 相较于已发布的 GSQ-RCO 工件提升了 PPL 和准确率，但在批量大小为 1 时解码速度为每秒 16.7 个 token，而发布版本为每秒 74.6 个 token（表 A3）。 这说明了为什么所测得的存储–质量提升本身并不足以确立加速效果，也说明了为什么必须将表示与内核放在一起考虑（Lin et al., 2024；Lin et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: AlphaEvolve optimizes algorithms and LLM-training infrastructure with coding agents ( Novikov et al., 2025 ) . The Darwin Gödel Machine modifies agent code and evaluates the resulting coding agents ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . We study a complementary efficiency objective: compressed model weights and their execution under a resource budget. The terminal task connects numerical choices and validation decisions to the quality of the executable model.
paragraphs.zh: AlphaEvolve 利用编码智能体优化算法与大语言模型训练基础设施（Novikov 等，2025）。 Darwin Gödel Machine 修改智能体代码并评估由此得到的编码智能体（Zhang 等，2026）。 我们研究一个互补的效率目标：在资源预算下压缩模型权重及其执行。 终端任务将数值选择与验证决策同可执行模型的质量联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Terminal-Bench evaluates agents on verified command-line tasks ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) ; Harbor provides a container-based framework for executing tasks and evaluating agents ( Harbor Framework Team, 2026 ) . SWE-bench studies repository repair ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , and AgentBench evaluates interactive environments ( Liu et al., 2024 ) . MLAgentBench, MLE-bench, and RE-Bench examine ML experimentation, competition solutions, and research engineering ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Chan et al., 2025 ; Wijk et al., 2025 ) . KernelBench tests correctness and runtime for specified tensor computations ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ) ; ServeLearnBench studies learning from serving feedback ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . Compression adds the choice of numerical approximation: the agent must select, implement, and validate a model whose generated answers remain useful.
paragraphs.zh: Terminal-Bench 在经过验证的命令行任务上评估智能体 ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) ；Harbor 提供了一个基于容器的框架，用于执行任务和评估智能体 ( Harbor Framework Team, 2026 ) 。 SWE-bench 研究仓库修复 ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) ，AgentBench 评估交互式环境 ( Liu et al., 2024 ) 。 MLAgentBench、MLE-bench 和 RE-Bench 分别考察机器学习实验、竞赛解答和研究工程 ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Chan et al., 2025 ; Wijk et al., 2025 ) 。 KernelBench 测试指定张量计算的正确性和运行时间 ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ) ；ServeLearnBench 研究从服务反馈中学习 ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) 。 压缩增加了数值逼近的选择：智能体必须选择、实现并验证一个其生成的答案仍然有用的模型。

paragraphs.en: GPTQ, AWQ, SmoothQuant, and OmniQuant use calibration to choose rounding, scaling, or clipping ( Frantar et al., 2023 ; Lin et al., 2024 ; Xiao et al., 2023 ; Shao et al., 2024 ) . QuIP, QuaRot, and SpinQuant improve quantization through incoherence processing or rotations ( Chee et al., 2023 ; Ashkboos et al., 2024b ; Liu et al., 2025 ) ; QuIP#, AQLM, and QTIP develop lattice, additive, or trellis representations ( Tseng et al., 2024a ; Egiazarian et al., 2024 ; Tseng et al., 2024b ) . HAWQ-V2 uses sensitivity for mixed precision ( Dong et al., 2020 ) , while GSQ and RCO optimize quantization and budget allocation ( Dadgarnia et al., 2026 ; Helcig and Alistarh, 2026 ) . Pruning removes weights or dimensions; low-rank methods reduce matrix rank ( Frantar and Alistarh, 2023 ; Sun et al., 2024 ; Ashkboos et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . Recovery can use quantization-aware fine-tuning ( Malinovskii et al., 2024 ) or distillation ( Hinton et al., 2015 ; Muralidharan et al., 2024 ) . Serving systems optimize memory management and attention execution ( Kwon et al., 2023 ; Ye et al., 2025 ) ; TinyChat and QServe couple quantized formats with matching kernels ( Lin et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: GPTQ、AWQ、SmoothQuant 和 OmniQuant 使用校准来选择舍入、缩放或裁剪（Frantar et al., 2023；Lin et al., 2024；Xiao et al., 2023；Shao et al., 2024）。 QuIP、QuaRot 和 SpinQuant 通过不相干处理或旋转变换来改进量化（Chee et al., 2023；Ashkboos et al., 2024b；Liu et al., 2025）；QuIP#、AQLM 和 QTIP 则开发了格、加性或格状（trellis）表示（Tseng et al., 2024a；Egiazarian et al., 2024；Tseng et al., 2024b）。 HAWQ-V2 利用敏感度进行混合精度量化（Dong et al., 2020），而 GSQ 和 RCO 则优化量化与预算分配（Dadgarnia et al., 2026；Helcig and Alistarh, 2026）。 剪枝会移除权重或维度；低秩方法则降低矩阵的秩（Frantar and Alistarh, 2023；Sun et al., 2024；Ashkboos et al., 2024a；Wang et al., 2025）。 恢复可以采用量化感知微调（Malinovskii et al., 2024）或蒸馏（Hinton et al., 2015；Muralidharan et al., 2024）。 服务系统会优化内存管理与注意力执行（Kwon et al., 2023；Ye et al., 2025）；TinyChat 和 QServe 将量化格式与匹配的内核相耦合（Lin et al., 2024；Lin et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: LLM compression provides a concrete task for studying agent-driven model improvement. Across 36 runs, 29 artifacts pass independent verification. Recorded searches show quality gains at nearly fixed storage, local rankings overturned by complete-model feedback, and generation or implementation failures missed by likelihood alone. Effective compression requires numerical design, experimental judgment, and validation of the final executable model. Extending this step toward RSI requires testing whether a compressed model retains the ability to carry out subsequent compression tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型压缩为研究智能体驱动的模型改进提供了一个具体任务。 在 36 次运行中，有 29 个产物通过了独立验证。 记录的搜索结果显示，在存储几乎不变的情况下质量有所提升，完整模型反馈推翻了局部排名，并且捕捉到了仅凭似然无法发现的生成或实现失败。 有效的压缩需要数值设计、实验判断以及对最终可执行模型的验证。 将这一步扩展到递归自我改进（RSI），需要测试压缩后的模型是否保留了执行后续压缩任务的能力。

paragraphs.en: Batch-one decode uses 2,048 input and 128 output tokens after warmup. TPS is 127 / L 127/L , where L L is the median of three round means, each over three first-to-last-token intervals. paragraphs.zh: 第一批解码在预热后使用 2,048 个输入 token 和 128 个输出 token。 TPS 为 127/L，其中 L 是三轮均值的取值的中位数，每轮均值覆盖三个从首 token 到末 token 的时间区间。 BF16 下 Nemotron、Qwen3.5 和 Qwen3.8 的速度分别为 147.5、158.3 和 61.4 tokens/s。 最终验证的超时时间为 3,600 秒。

paragraphs.en: We examine how agents use the design budget and when they stop revising weights ( Figure A1 ). Agents were instructed to carry out agentic design end to end until the time limit. Runs proceeded without human intervention or follow-up prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 我们考察智能体如何使用设计预算，以及它们何时停止修改权重（图 A1）。 智能体被指示端到端地执行智能体式设计，直至时限。 各次运行在没有人工干预或后续提示的情况下进行。

sents.en: Agents were instructed to carry out agentic design end to end until the time limit.
sents.zh: 智能体被指示端到端地执行智能体式设计，直至时限。

paragraphs.en: Seventeen runs change weights after the agent first declares the task complete: five Kimi runs, four each for Opus and DeepSeek, two each for GLM and MiniMax, and none for Sonnet. Kimi has the earliest median first completion declaration and usually continues revising its weights. Median GPU-busy shares range from 30% to 60% across agents. These records distinguish a declaration of completion from the last effective model change.
paragraphs.zh: 有十七次运行在智能体首次宣布任务完成后仍然更改了权重：Kimi 有五次，Opus 和 DeepSeek 各四次，GLM 和 MiniMax 各两次，Sonnet 则为零次。 Kimi 的首次完成宣布中位时间最早，并且通常会继续修改其权重。 各智能体的 GPU 忙碌时长占比中位数介于 30% 到 60% 之间。 这些记录将完成宣布与最后一次有效模型更改区分开来。

paragraphs.en: On Qwen3.8 at 8 GiB, Opus’s reallocation lowers verification PPL increase from 6.17% to 5.89%. Distillation lowers it to 5.00%, then further allocation and training reach 4.64%. GSM8K accuracy falls from 88% to 72% across trained versions, while the other benchmark changes are smaller.
paragraphs.zh: 在配备 8 GiB 内存的 Qwen3.8 上，Opus 的重新分配将验证 PPL 的增幅从 6.17% 降至 5.89%。 蒸馏将其进一步降至 5.00%，随后通过进一步的分配和训练达到 4.64%。 在各训练版本中，GSM8K 的准确率从 88% 下降到 72%，而其他基准测试的变化较小。

sents.en: On Qwen3.8 at 8 GiB, Opus’s reallocation lowers verification PPL increase from 6.17% to 5.89%.
sents.zh: 在配备 8 GiB 内存的 Qwen3.8 上，Opus 的重新分配将验证 PPL 的增幅从 6.17% 降至 5.89%。

sents.en: Distillation lowers it to 5.00%, then further allocation and training reach 4.64%.
sents.zh: 蒸馏将其进一步降至 5.00%，随后通过进一步的分配和训练达到 4.64%。

sents.en: GSM8K accuracy falls from 88% to 72% across trained versions, while the other benchmark changes are smaller.
sents.zh: 在各训练版本中，GSM8K 的准确率从 88% 下降到 72%，而其他基准测试的变化较小。

paragraphs.en: Pilot compression runs on Qwen3.8 27B inform the task allowances and storage accounting. Pilot PPL is measured on 256 held-out C4 ( Raffel et al., 2020 ) contexts of 2,048 tokens, with BF16 PPL 9.9227. The main study instead evaluates source-generated continuations.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Qwen3.8 27B 上的试点压缩运行结果为任务配额和存储核算提供了依据。 试点 PPL 在 256 个各含 2,048 个词元的留出 C4（Raffel et al., 2020）上下文上测得，BF16 PPL 为 9.9227。 主研究则改为评估由源文本生成的续写内容。

sents.en: Pilot compression runs on Qwen3.8 27B inform the task allowances and storage accounting.
sents.zh: 在 Qwen3.8 27B 上的试点压缩运行结果为任务配额和存储核算提供了依据。

sents.en: Pilot PPL is measured on 256 held-out C4 ( Raffel et al., 2020 ) contexts of 2,048 tokens, with BF16 PPL 9.9227.

sents.zh: 主研究则改为评估由源文本生成的续写内容。

paragraphs.en: Table A4 compares compression choices across four storage allowances. Pilot timing follows the first-to-last-token protocol in Section 7 with an earlier vLLM release.
paragraphs.zh: 表 A4 比较了四种存储额度下的压缩方案选择。 试点的时间安排遵循第 7 节中的首令牌至末令牌协议，并使用较早发布的 vLLM 版本。

sents.en: Table A4 compares compression choices across four storage allowances.
sents.zh: 表 A4 比较了四种存储额度下的压缩方案选择。

paragraphs.en: At 16 GiB, finer groups lower PPL but increase metadata storage; the group-32 configuration exceeds the limit. At 12 GiB, mixed three- and four-bit weights improve on uniform three-bit quantization. At 8 GiB, similar package sizes yield different PPL. These results motivate paired limits that expose precision-allocation and representation decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 在 16 GiB 时，更细的分组可降低困惑度，但会增加元数据存储；group-32 配置超出了限制。 在 12 GiB 时，三比特与四比特混合权重的效果优于统一三比特量化。 在 8 GiB 时，相近的包大小却产生不同的困惑度。 这些结果促使我们引入成对的限制，以暴露精度分配和表示方式的决策。

sents.en: At 16 GiB, finer groups lower PPL but increase metadata storage; the group-32 configuration exceeds the limit.
sents.zh: 在 16 GiB 时，更细的分组可降低困惑度，但会增加元数据存储；group-32 配置超出了限制。

sents.en: At 12 GiB, mixed three- and four-bit weights improve on uniform three-bit quantization.
sents.zh: 在 12 GiB 时，三比特与四比特混合权重的效果优于统一三比特量化。

sents.en: At 8 GiB, similar package sizes yield different PPL.
sents.zh: 在 8 GiB 时，相近的包大小却产生不同的困惑度。

sents.en: These results motivate paired limits that expose precision-allocation and representation decisions.
sents.zh: 这些结果促使我们引入成对的限制，以暴露精度分配和表示方式的决策。

paragraphs.en: The pilot QAT Q2_0 release uses llama.cpp; the remaining releases in Table A5 use vLLM.
paragraphs.zh: 试运行的 QAT Q2_0 版本使用 llama.cpp；表 A5 中的其余版本使用 vLLM。

paragraphs.en: A QTIP pilot package occupies 6.96 GiB with PPL 20.84% above BF16, but retains BF16 weights during execution; agent pilots also retain high-precision copies. The low-bit GGUF releases keep resident storage within 0.24 GiB of package size. These measurements motivate separate allowances for saved packages and resident weights.
paragraphs.zh: 一个 QTIP 试点包占用 6.96 GiB，其 PPL 比 BF16 高 20.84%，但在执行期间保留 BF16 权重；智能体试点同样保留高精度副本。 低比特 GGUF 发布版使常驻存储保持在比包大小多 0.24 GiB 以内。 这些测量结果说明应为已保存的包和常驻权重分别设定不同的配额。

sents.en: A QTIP pilot package occupies 6.96 GiB with PPL 20.84% above BF16, but retains BF16 weights during execution; agent pilots also retain high-precision copies.
sents.zh: 一个 QTIP 试点包占用 6.96 GiB，其 PPL 比 BF16 高 20.84%，但在执行期间保留 BF16 权重；智能体试点同样保留高精度副本。

sents.zh: 低比特 GGUF 发布版使常驻存储保持在比包大小多 0.24 GiB 以内。

sents.en: These measurements motivate separate allowances for saved packages and resident weights.
sents.zh: 这些测量结果说明应为已保存的包和常驻权重分别设定不同的配额。

paragraphs.zh: 主研究中使用的发布量化版本已在表 A3 中通过其验证结果进行了标识。

paragraphs.en: We repeat GLM 5.3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on one dense and one MoE task ( Table A6 ). Four fresh trials use empty workspaces, the original checkpoints, prompts, and verification protocol, Claude Code through Fireworks, maximum reasoning effort, eight hours, and one H200 NVL.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个稠密任务和一个 MoE 任务上复现了 GLM 5.3 和 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash（表 A6）。 四次全新试验使用空工作区、原始检查点、提示词和验证协议、通过 Fireworks 接入的 Claude Code、最大推理力度、八小时以及一块 H200 NVL。

sents.en: We repeat GLM 5.3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on one dense and one MoE task ( Table A6 ).
sents.zh: 我们在一个稠密任务和一个 MoE 任务上复现了 GLM 5.3 和 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash（表 A6）。

paragraphs.en: All four repeats pass final verification. Their PPL values lie within 0.81% of the corresponding original designs, with the largest shift in GLM’s dense-model repeat.
paragraphs.zh: 全部四次重复均通过最终验证。 其 PPL 值与对应的原始设计相差在 0.81% 以内，其中最大偏移出现在 GLM 的稠密模型重复中。

paragraphs.en: We compare clipping-range selection and GPTQ error compensation in GLM’s repeated dense and MoE designs ( Table A7 ). Paired variants share source weights, calibration, precision allocation, group sizes, and inference. The MoE scales and channel order remain fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在GLM的重复稠密与MoE设计中比较裁剪范围选择与GPTQ误差补偿（表A7）。 配对变体共享源权重、校准、精度分配、分组大小和推理方式。 MoE的缩放因子与通道顺序保持固定。

sents.en: We compare clipping-range selection and GPTQ error compensation in GLM’s repeated dense and MoE designs ( Table A7 ).
sents.zh: 我们在GLM的重复稠密与MoE设计中比较裁剪范围选择与GPTQ误差补偿（表A7）。

paragraphs.en: Clipping-range refinement in the dense model and GPTQ error compensation in the MoE model both lower verification PPL at identical model storage. Compensation reduces negative log-likelihood on 197 of 256 MoE verification contexts.
